title: Bound object fields and retain accepted findings

context.hint: Bound structural expansion of worker-produced findings before JSON parsing.
context.surface: A parent process validates findings documents supplied by a lower-trust worker.
assumptions: Run resource probes in disposable subprocesses with an external timeout.

review.invariant: Pre-parse field budgets reject excess object fields while accepting ordinary worker findings.
review.verification: Check field counts at and above the configured limit and compare accepted ordinary and empty findings through the normal CLI.

source_observation.summary: The field limit was absent on the baseline. Both new regressions and the full 67-test repaired suite passed. Ordinary and empty CLI output controls passed. Only the tested runtime and operating system were covered.
